content_zh:
不过她现在换上了一身白大褂，透着几分职业女人知性的魅力，格外养眼。
“不好意思，医生，刚才在路边，是我太着急了……”
定了定心神后，宁小凡歉意笑道。
“你是病人的家属吗？这样还能理解…”
女医生撇了撇小嘴，旋即看向躺在床上的楚惜颜，脸色不由惊喜，“你醒了？”
楚惜颜回了她一个虚弱的微笑。
“这……这是什么！？”
女医生走近一步，竟然发现楚惜颜脑门上插着一根银针，当即对楚海山怒道：
“我明白你是救女心切，可也不能乱用江湖偏方吧！你知道人体穴位有多复杂吗？就敢乱插，还不快拔掉！”
她娇颜愠怒，都快气死了。
上次在医院，就有一个病人埋怨医疗治疗费用太贵，擅自请来江湖术士，结果活生生把人治死。后来，病人家属还跟医院打官司，简直不可理喻。
“咳咳。”
魏青衫在一旁轻咳几声。
“魏爷爷，您怎么在这儿？”
女医生转过头，这才发现魏青衫的存在，一抹惊喜飞快浮上娇颜，“难道这些银针是您所施？怪不得呢，病人这么快就醒了。”
“安然，你魏爷爷哪有这样的本事啊。”
魏青衫哑然失笑，捋了捋胡子后，看向宁小凡，“是他。”
“他？”
女医生安然眨巴了一下杏眸，不可思议的看着宁小凡，喃喃道：“莫非你是魏爷爷的弟子？”
宁小凡嘴角抽搐了两下，心想这老头当他弟子还差不多呢…

他没理安然，只是把楚海山单独叫了出来。
安然见他这副不屑与之交谈的样子，气得香腮鼓鼓的。旋即，她替楚惜颜检查了一下神经指标，俏脸渐渐附上一层骇然之色。
“你没事了？”
“小凡，你有什么事就直说吧。”
走廊尽头，楚海山感激地看着宁小凡，他女儿的救命恩人。
宁小凡也不来虚的，径直道：
“楚叔叔，惜颜昏迷太久了，导致颅内形成血肿，还有一些感染，后续需要养好身子，否则容易留下后遗症，这是我写的一些注意事项，你看看……”
宁小凡说着，将一张刚刚在病房里写的医嘱拿出来，递给楚海山。
后者微笑地伸手接过，也递过来一张卡片，那是一张印刻着金龙的银行卡。
“这是？”宁小凡有些诧异。
“自然是你的报酬。”
楚海山微微一笑，“你救了我女儿的命，如果我没有一点表示的话，传出去岂不被朋友们笑话死？况且……”
他顿了顿，神色有些尴尬，“我知道你出身农村，家里经济条件不太好，这一百万你先拿去改善生活吧。”
一百万！
宁小凡瞳孔缩了缩，说实话，他一辈子都没见过这么一大笔钱！
上次用金元宝兑换二十万，已经是一笔巨款了，再来一百万，足以彻底颠覆他的生活。
不能要？
开玩笑，凭什么不要！
自己救了他女儿的命，难道楚家大小姐的命，不值这区区一百万？
脑中飞快闪过几个念头，宁小凡没有犹豫，伸手拿过来。

“谢谢伯父。”
“不用，我还怕这钱太少，你看不上眼呢！”
楚海山哈哈大笑，显然心情极好。他对人才，一向是求贤若渴，更何况是宁小凡这样，连魏青衫都自愧不如的天才神医！
“哪能啊。”宁小凡一笑。
“小凡，你放心吧，学校那边我会去处理，不会让你惹上麻烦。”
陡然间，楚海山眼神变得有些狠辣，“顾家的那个小畜牲，我不会放过他的！”
宁小凡点点头。
过了一会儿，宁小凡正想走，魏青衫带着美女医生安然走了出来，脸上有着一抹喟然。
“等等，宁小友。”
“魏老头，有事吗？”
赚了一百万，宁小凡心情显然不错。
“诶，你这人，能不能有点尊老爱幼的素质啊！”
安然撇了撇樱唇，纵然是燕京的那些青年俊才见了她魏爷爷，也得乖乖叫一声魏老，这货倒好，一口一个魏老头！
“医不论辈，达者为师，无妨无妨。”魏青衫淡抚胡须，不见恼怒。
“魏老头，你有事没？没事我可走了啊。”宁小凡道。
“慢。”
魏青衫从嘴里吐出一个字，旋即在身后摸了摸，将那装有十二根冰魄银针的黑檀木盒，放在了宁小凡手上。
放下去后，他脸上明显有一丝如释重负。

content_en:
However, she is now wearing a white coat, which exudes a bit of the intellectual charm of a professional woman, which is particularly eye-catching.
"I'm sorry, doctor, I was on the roadside just now. I was too anxious..."
After calming down, Ning Xiaofan smiled apologetically.
"Are you a family member of the patient? Is this understandable..."
The female doctor pouted her lips, and immediately looked at Chu Xiyan who was lying on the bed, with a look of surprise on her face, "Are you awake?"
Chu Xiyan returned her a weak smile.
"What...what is this!?"
The female doctor took a step closer and found a silver needle stuck in Chu Xiyan's forehead. She immediately said angrily to Chu Haishan:
"I understand that you are eager to save your daughter, but you can't use folk remedies indiscriminately! Do you know how complicated the acupoints on the human body are? If you dare to insert them randomly, why don't you pull them out!"
She was so charming and sullen that she was almost mad to death.
Last time I was in the hospital, a patient complained that the cost of medical treatment was too expensive, so he hired a charlatan without permission, and ended up treating the patient to death. Later, the patient's family filed a lawsuit against the hospital, which was simply unreasonable.
"Ahem."
Wei Qingshan coughed lightly at the side.
"Grandpa Wei, why are you here?"
The female doctor turned her head and discovered the presence of Wei Qingshan. A touch of surprise quickly appeared on her face, "Did you inject these silver needles? No wonder, the patient woke up so quickly."
"An Ran, how can your Grandpa Wei have such ability?"
Wei Qingshan laughed dumbly. After stroking his beard, he looked at Ning Xiaofan and said, "It's him."
"Him?"
The female doctor An Ran blinked her almond-shaped eyes, looked at Ning Xiaofan in disbelief, and murmured: "Could it be that you are Grandpa Wei's disciple?"
The corner of Ning Xiaofan's mouth twitched twice, thinking that this old man would be enough to be his disciple...
He ignored An Ran and just called Chu Haishan out alone.
An Ran was so angry when she saw that he didn't bother to talk to him. Immediately, she checked Chu Xiyan's neurological indicators, and a look of horror gradually appeared on her pretty face.
"Are you okay?"
"Xiao Fan, if you have anything to say, just tell me."
At the end of the corridor, Chu Haishan looked gratefully at Ning Xiaofan, his daughter's savior.
Ning Xiaofan didn’t want to be vain and said directly:
"Uncle Chu, Xiyan has been in coma for too long, which has resulted in the formation of hematomas in the brain and some infections. You need to take good care of yourself in the future, otherwise it will easily leave sequelae. These are some precautions I wrote. Take a look..."
As Ning Xiaofan said this, he took out a medical order he had just written in the ward and handed it to Chu Haishan.
The latter reached out to take it with a smile, and also handed over a card, which was a bank card with a golden dragon engraved on it.
"This is?" Ning Xiaofan was a little surprised.
"Of course it's your reward."
Chu Haishan smiled slightly and said, "You saved my daughter's life. If I didn't express anything, wouldn't my friends laugh me to death if word got out? Besides..."
He paused and looked a little embarrassed, "I know you were born in a rural area and your family's financial situation is not very good. You should use this million to improve your life first."
One million!
Ning Xiaofan's pupils shrank. To be honest, he had never seen such a large amount of money in his life!
The last time he exchanged gold ingots for 200,000 yuan, it was already a huge sum of money. Another million yuan would be enough to completely overturn his life.
Can't have it?
Just kidding, why not?
He saved his daughter's life. Is the life of the eldest daughter of the Chu family not worth a mere million?
Several thoughts flashed through his mind, and Ning Xiaofan reached out to take it without hesitation.
"Thank you, uncle."
"No, I'm afraid the money is too little and you won't like it!"
Chu Haishan laughed, obviously in a good mood. He has always been thirsty for talents, not to mention a genius doctor like Ning Xiaofan who even Wei Qingshan would be ashamed of!
"No way." Ning Xiaofan smiled.
"Xiaofan, don't worry, I will handle it at the school and I won't let you get into trouble."
Suddenly, Chu HaishanHis eyes became a little fierce, "That little beast of the Gu family, I won't let him go!"
Ning Xiaofan nodded.
After a while, when Ning Xiaofan was about to leave, Wei Qingshan walked out safely with the beautiful doctor, a look of sigh on his face.
"Wait, little friend Ning."
"Old man Wei, is something wrong?"
After earning one million, Ning Xiaofan was obviously in a good mood.
"Hey, can you be a person who respects the elderly and loves the young?"
An Ran curled her lips. Even those young talents from Yanjing had to call her "Grandpa Wei" when they saw her. This guy is so good, he is like "Old Wei"!
"Doctors don't care about their seniority. Those who are masters are teachers, so it doesn't matter." Wei Qingshan stroked his beard lightly, but there was no sign of anger.
"Old man Wei, are you okay? If nothing happens, I can go." Ning Xiaofan said.
"Slow."
Wei Qingshan uttered a word from his mouth, then touched behind his back and placed the ebony box containing twelve ice soul silver needles in Ning Xiaofan's hand.
After putting it down, there was a clear trace of relief on his face.
